error_semantics.upstream_code: Numeric code retained as a separate property and in sanitized exception text; no invented code when absent.

error_semantics.partial_visible_content_on_native_error: Rejected as an error; never patient output.
error_semantics.successful_stop_length_safety_responses: Original normalization and source-specific acceptance remain unchanged.
